blocks.text: Langley Condos Under $399K: streets and boundaries

items.t: This page is a price band, not a neighbourhood: its condos sit in two separate municipalities, the City of Langley and the Township of Langley, and which municipality a building is in decides its bylaws, utility billing and tax notice.

The City of Langley share of the band is the downtown apartment stock around 200 Street, 56 Avenue and Fraser Highway, the same corridor where the City's own May 2026 development report lists its current apartment applications.

The Township of Langley share sits mainly in Willoughby Heights and at Aldergrove Town Centre, and the Township publishes every current development application on its Development Activity map and portal, searchable by address or community.

blocks.text: Langley Condos Under $399K: the housing stock

items.t: The under-$399K band is mostly older low-rise strata stock in the City of Langley plus newer low- and mid-rise product in the Township, and the age gap matters because of one provincial deadline: strata corporations in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley that had no depreciation report, or a report received before December 31, 2020, had to obtain a current one by July 1, 2026.

Every strata corporation in British Columbia, of any size, must carry property and liability insurance for the strata corporation, so an older building in this band should have a current policy and a stated deductible position a buyer can read before subject removal.

Township of Langley condos are billed utilities at the Township's multi-family flat rate, while City of Langley condos sit on metered water — the same band therefore carries two different utility structures depending on which side of the municipal boundary the building stands.

blocks.text: Langley Condos Under $399K: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A depreciation report is now mandatory on a five-year cycle for every British Columbia strata corporation with five or more strata lots, and stratas can no longer defer it by an annual three-quarter vote — in this band that rule lands hardest on the older City of Langley low-rise buildings.

Rental, pet and age rules for a Langley condo come from that building's own registered strata bylaws and the seller's Form B information certificate, not from either Langley municipality; the Province's strata housing pages are the official starting point for what those documents must disclose.

In the City of Langley, land designated Mid Rise Residential is subject to a development permit for building form and character, which is the rule shaping the new apartment buildings joining this stock — the City's Bylaw No. 3303 (2025) rezoned 20239–20249 54A Avenue from RM1 Multiple Residential Low Density to CD105 Comprehensive Development on that basis.

blocks.text: Langley Condos Under $399K: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Township of Langley utility fees no longer ride on the property tax statement: the Township has mailed a separate flat-rate utility statement since 2025, due July 2, 2026, and a 10 percent penalty applies to unpaid utility balances after the due date.
City of Langley residential water meters are read once a year in March and the charge is billed on the June tax notice, so a City condo's water cost arrives with taxes, not as a monthly bill.

H.D. Stafford Middle School in the City of Langley takes students from six named elementary catchments — Blacklock Fine Arts, Douglas Park, James Hill, Nicomekl, Simonds and Uplands — and its Grade 8s transition to Langley Secondary School, which is the school path behind most City of Langley condo addresses.
Langley Memorial Hospital, the Fraser Health community hospital for both Langleys, is at 22051 Fraser Highway — inside the City of Langley condo corridor, not out in the Township.

A buyer can subscribe to the Township's Development Activity Portal to get email notices of new applications near a specific building, because applications become public within about three weeks of acceptance.

The City of Langley's 2026 single-family solid waste charge is $432, but multi-family buildings are billed under the City's metered utility structure instead — do not carry a house utility figure into a condo budget.

blocks.text: Langley Condos Under $399K: costs and taxes

items.t: The condo-specific Township of Langley charge is the multi-family utility flat rate: $667.22 for water plus $609.00 for sanitary sewer per year in 2026, $1,276.22 in total, with a garbage base rate of $226.00 where Township collection applies.
The condo-specific City of Langley charge is metered: water at $2.06 per cubic metre plus a $75 fee, and sewer on 80 percent of water consumption at $2.41 per cubic metre plus a $75 fee, for 2026.

The Surrey-Langley SkyTrain extension runs along Fraser Highway to a terminus at 203 Street in Langley City, with an anticipated in-service date of 2029 on TransLink's project page — until it opens, every condo in this band is bus-served.
Fraser Highway is the spine for both halves of the band: it carries the City of Langley's apartment corridor and continues east through the Township to Aldergrove Town Centre.

blocks.text: Langley Condos Under $399K: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with the depreciation report: for any building in this band, ask whether the strata met the July 1, 2026 Fraser Valley deadline and read the report's funding models, because an underfunded contingency reserve in an older low-rise building is where a special levy comes from after you buy.

Read the strata's insurance position on the Province's strata insurance page and in the Form B: the strata corporation must insure the common property at full replacement value, and the deductible an owner can be charged back after a water loss is a building-level figure no municipal page states.

Confirm the school catchment for the exact unit address in School District 35's locator, and re-check it against the September 2027 Willoughby Slope boundary changes before relying on a school name in a listing.
Strata disputes in British Columbia can be taken to the Civil Resolution Tribunal, which is the official route if a strata records or bylaw dispute follows a purchase.

faq.q: Why does the July 1, 2026 depreciation report deadline matter for a cheap Langley condo?
faq.a: Because the deadline applied exactly to this band's older buildings: strata corporations in the Fraser Valley with no report, or one received before December 31, 2020, had to obtain a current report by July 1, 2026. A fresh report shows the building's projected repair and replacement costs over 30 years and how the contingency reserve fund (CRF) is funded, which is where special levies in older low-rise buildings come from. Ask for the report and the CRF balance before subject removal.

faq.q: Is a condo in the City of Langley billed for utilities the same way as one in the Township?
faq.a: No — the two municipalities bill differently. City of Langley properties are on water meters: the 2026 water rate is $2.06 per cubic metre plus a $75 fee, and sewer is charged on 80 percent of consumption at $2.41 per cubic metre plus $75. Township of Langley condos instead pay a flat annual multi-family rate — $667.22 for water and $609.00 for sanitary sewer in 2026 — billed on a separate utility statement.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Willoughby Heights condo, and is that changing?
faq.a: Catchments in School District 35 (Langley) are set by exact address through the district's school locator, and Willoughby Slope catchments change in September 2027 when two new schools open — stɑtl̓əw̓ Middle and Emery Dosdall Secondary. Under the new map, Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (East) feeds stɑtl̓əw̓ Middle then Emery Dosdall Secondary, while Donna Gabriel Robins (West) feeds Peter Ewart Middle then R.E. Mountain Secondary, so two units on the same street can split.

faq.q: Can I rent out a condo I buy in this band?
faq.a: The answer sits in the building's own documents, not in a municipal rule. Rental restrictions, pet limits and any age bylaw are set by the strata corporation's registered bylaws, and the seller's Form B information certificate is the document that discloses the bylaws and rules that apply to the specific strata lot.

faq.q: Where are the under-$399K condos in Langley?
faq.a: On the first page read: Aldergrove Town Centre (new Vanetta product at 27254 Aldergrove Town Centre Drive), Willoughby Heights (197 Street, 80 Avenue, 208b Street, 78b Avenue) and Langley City resale buildings (53a Avenue, 54th Avenue, 200 Street, Fraser Highway). At community level the attached pool concentrates in Willoughby Heights (369 listings) and the Langley City sub-area (195) (SnapStats, September 2026)

faq.q: Which school district serves Langley, and how are catchments set?
faq.a: SD35 Langley; catchments are address-based — at the recorded Willoughby sample (7888 200 Street) the locator gives Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, Peter Ewart Middle School and R.E. Mountain Secondary; no catchment for the specific Aldergrove Town Centre or Langley City condo addresses on this page is on record in this file, so confirm any address with the SD35 School Locator.
